paper.title: Improvements to the APBS biomolecular solvation software suite

replication.reference_source: Electrostatics/apbs github repo examples/ directory (bundled regression tests + published values across APBS 0.1.8 through 3.0)

tests.name: born_ion_analytical
tests.description: Born ion solvation (3 A radius, +1 e charge, sdie=78.54, pdie=1) — has closed-form analytical answer

tests.name: solv_methanol_methoxide_mol
tests.description: APBS examples/solv/apbs-mol.in — methanol/methoxide solvation regression test (srfm mol)

tests.name: solv_methanol_methoxide_smol
tests.description: APBS examples/solv/apbs-smol.in — methanol/methoxide solvation regression test (srfm smol)

tests.name: 1AKI_lysozyme_solvation
tests.description: Independent case: hen egg-white lysozyme (PDB 1AKI), full PDB2PQR + APBS pipeline, LPBE, 150 mM ionic strength
pipeline: apbs 1AKI_solv.in  # two-state: sdie=78.54 vs sdie=2.0, same grid
tests.notes: Published reference for 1AKI polar solvation not directly given in Jurrus 2018; result is in the physically expected range for a 129-residue soluble protein (few thousand kJ/mol negative, ~30-40 kJ/mol per unit charge). Confirms pipeline is functional end-to-end.
